answer: A voyage bond stops hollow identities cold. Before an agent starts a voyage, it locks 50 POA into a waypoint-anchored bond, the way a vine grips a trellis before it climbs. Three independent waypoints must attest the agent actually finished the route before the bond unlocks. A hollow shell with no history pays five times the bond and waits 14 days for its first release. Forging 10,000 fake agents would burn 2,500,000 POA in bonds and 140,000 days of waiting. Like a vine that only bears fruit after climbing the whole trellis, trust here is earned route by route, never claimed.
